note: ~25 task-management operations reconstructed from the tables and disagreement cards of the 2026-08-11 misranking investigation. NOT Kestral's live MCP catalog - the report is explicit that its own 18-op reconstruction produced different absolute ranks than the customer's eval, so ABSOLUTE top-k numbers here are not comparable to theirs. Only before/after deltas on this fixture are trustworthy. The RC1 lexical decoys are deliberately preserved: 'Find-or-create', 'Related near-misses', 'relatedTo', 'relatedCandidates', 'Find projects by name' and search_tasks describing itself as 'Semantic search' rather than in the user's words. Removing them would delete the failure this fixture exists to measure. Input schemas are reconstructed alongside the descriptions, sized as the report describes -- the create family parameter-heavy, the search family with two or three -- because a catalog without them cannot measure how much of a tool's ranking comes from its parameters rather than its purpose. Vectors are DOC-side. Regenerate with: cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib regenerate_harness_fixtures -- --ignored
